**[L-Arginine inhibits NLRP3 inflammasome activation.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42839106/)** *(from Nutrition/metabolism (with neurology via Parkinson's disease models and rheumatology via gout))*  
*Liu Feng; Zhuang Wanxin; Yang Yuan; Zhao Wenting; Zhang Chao* — Nature metabolism 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `NLRP3, urate-NLRP3, treatment-target`  
> L-Arginine binds NLRP3 at Asp31 to block ASC interaction and inflammasome assembly, and it alleviates MSU crystal-induced arthritis; this acts directly on the downstream NLRP3 node of the Purple (ox-mtDNA) and Gold (uric acid/MSU) streams and suggests a low-toxicity nutritional treatment, though it does not involve SAMHD1, mtDNA, or the interferon axis.  
DOI: 10.1038/s42255-026-01636-3

**[Nucleotide stress in chronic inflammatory memory: Mitochondrial DNA damage and NAD+-dependent PARP1 chromatin dynamics.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42833456/)** *(from Free radical biology / redox biochemistry and chromatin epigenetics (PARP1-NAD+ DNA repair))*  
*Han Xie; Wu Ling; Li JiaKuo; Zu WeiTing; Zhao Mei* — Free radical biology & medicine 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `POLG-mtDNA, cGAS-STING, NLRP3, nucleotide-rewiring, mito-dNTP-transport, dNTPase, mito-ROS-NF-kB, ME-CFS, other`  
> This hypothesis/review frames dNTP/rNTP imbalance and NAD+ limitation as a link between oxidized mtDNA (8-oxo-dG, ribonucleotide incorporation), cGAS-STING/NLRP3 priming and persistent sterile inflammation, which closely parallels the SAMHD1 haploinsufficiency mechanism of dNTP pool expansion, POLG stalling, ox-mtDNA and NLRP3 activation. It does not address SAMHD1 or A565T directly, and the PARP1/NAD+ chromatin component is a novel but unproven add-on that could bear on chronic inflammatory memory and ME/CFS.  
DOI: 10.1016/j.freeradbiomed.2026.10.007
